about_the_game:
Mommy’s Slipper is a hilarious stealth-escape game where you must sneak around a quiet town, collect items, and avoid being stunned by an angry mom's flying slipper.

Explore small houses, sheds, and alleys to find a way out. Hide under beds or inside wardrobes when you hear her footsteps. But be quick — one wrong move, and the slipper finds you.

Inspired by the universal childhood fear of the flying slipper, Mommy’s Slipper mixes light horror, stealth, and cartoon-style humor in a short and replayable single-player experience.

Can you escape the town… or will you get bonked again?

Features

  • A unique mix of stealth and comedy

  • Hide under beds or inside wardrobes

  • Avoid detection by a reactive AI mom

  • Collect useful items and unlock paths

  • Stylized 3D graphics and light horror tone

  • No gore, no violence — just pure slipper-powered chaos

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 or Intel HD Graphics 4600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8300H
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
